items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Dan and I would always rush over to hear Ray... then he started playing with my mother and he took Dan's place.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, the piano player did most of the arranging. Spencer,yeah. But I used to -- when we'd

get off of my job, Dan and I would always rush over to hear Ray. They were playing a club in Chicago, by the name of Dave's. And everybody would go there. Do you know when this was? This was 1932. Were you born then?
